title: FC Eval Result
description: One formatting-checklist (FC) grading result for a single Wiki Output File (WOF). This is the FC instance of a shared eval envelope: the rubric eval reuses the same envelope with eval="rubric" and every item engine="model"; the GBF eval reuses the $defs below but swaps the item status vocabulary (agree/contradict/omit). Emitted files are plain JSON with no comments. Implement the writer as Pydantic v2 models that mirror this schema.

eval.description: Which eval produced this file. Const "fc" here so the FC schema validates strictly; rubric/gbf are sibling schemas that reuse the $defs below.

schema_version.description: Version of THIS envelope shape (not the criteria). Bump only when the envelope structure changes; editing a criterion's text does not bump it.

wof.description: Filename or path of the graded Wiki Output File. This is the join key that ties the fc/rubric/gbf results for one run together.

graded_at.description: UTC timestamp when this result was produced.

graders.description: Who/what produced the results. FC has two entries: the mechanical linter and the model adjudicator. Rubric/GBF have a single model grader.

items.description: One entry per criterion evaluated. Keyed by stable id; the full FC id set lives in patterns-checklist.md.

engine.description: Which engine judged this: "mechanical" = deterministic Python (the linter), "model" = the LLM adjudicator.

status.description: Result for one criterion. pass/fail as expected. partial = partially met; it SCORES as a fail but is kept visible for the review. na = criterion does not apply to this WOF (e.g. the optional title checks when the WOF has no top-level # title); excluded from the denominator. skipped = not evaluated this run (e.g. the model pass was disabled, or no API key); excluded from the denominator AND flips summary.complete to false, so a partial run is never mistaken for a full one.

evidence.description: Why the status was assigned. Required on every item, including passes (kept terse for mechanical passes).

lines.description: Line number(s) in the WOF the finding refers to. Empty for whole-document checks (e.g. a global uniqueness check).

detail.description: Terse finding for mechanical checks (a count or the offending value); a one-line rationale for model checks.

expected.description: Optional. For mechanical comparisons: what was expected.

found.description: Optional. For mechanical comparisons: what was actually present.

id.description: Stable criterion id (dotted slug, e.g. fc.anchors.unique-ids). This is the ONLY join key; results reference the id, never the prose. The authoritative id->text map is patterns-checklist.md.

description.description: Informational copy of the criterion text so the JSON reads without cross-referencing the checklist. NOT authoritative and may drift; the id wins. Safe to omit.

summary.description: Tally over items[]. items[] is the source of truth; a consumer should be able to recompute this and flag a mismatch.

partial.description: Counts toward fail in scoring; surfaced separately for the review.

skipped.description: Excluded from the denominator; any value > 0 forces complete=false.

applicable.description: pass + partial + fail. The scoring denominator (na and skipped excluded).

score.description: pass / applicable, in 0..1. By convention, null when applicable == 0 (document the choice).

complete.description: false when skipped > 0, i.e. some criteria were not evaluated this run. Makes a provisional FC grade visibly provisional.

name.description: Model id as the provider names it.

endpoint.description: Optional. Pinned provider or base_url, for reproducibility.

temperature.description: Low, but NOT greedy for Qwen3 (its card discourages greedy decoding). ~0.6-0.7.

thinking.description: Qwen3 thinking mode. Keep false for a clean JSON judge (no <think> block).

votes.description: Self-consistency runs; majority vote per item. 1 = no voting; 3-5 for stability.

grader.description: A mechanical grader or a model grader, discriminated on engine.
